newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Lending pressure keeps Pakistan money rates low.
newsitem.headline: Lending pressure keeps Pakistan money rates low.

text.p: The Pakistani money market rates closed at low levels on Tuesday amid a lending pressure by holders of surplus funds, dealers said.
Heavy lending pressure continued throughout the day with the overnight market trading between 2.5 and 4.0 percent, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.

The lenders offered at 2.5 percent later in the day but there were no bids at the time and the market closed with surplus funds, he said. The rates on Wednewday will depend on the result of a central bank weekly open market operation, he added. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
